# UP Elections Complete Info (llms-full.txt)

> This document contains the full aggregated textual context of UPElectionResults.com for easy ingestion by AI agents and language models.

---

## 1. Portal Overview
UP Elections 2027 is an independent, non-partisan election database covering the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha).
* **Domain**: https://upelectionresults.com
* **Total Constituencies**: 403
* **Majority Mark**: 202 seats
* **Voters**: ~15.02 Crore registered voters
* **Districts**: 75 administrative districts

---

## 2. Core Political Parties in Uttar Pradesh
* **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**: Current ruling party. Secured landslide victories in both 2017 (312 seats) and 2022 (255 seats) under Yogi Adityanath.
* **Samajwadi Party (SP)**: Main opposition party in UP, led by former Chief Minister Akhilesh Yadav. Secured 111 seats in the 2022 elections.
* **Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP)**: National party led by Mayawati, focusing on Dalit representation. Historically held power in UP.
* **Indian National Congress (INC)**: National party. Contested in alliances.
* **Rashtriya Lok Dal (RLD)**: Regional party active in Western UP, representing farmer interests.

---

## 3. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: When is the UP Assembly Election 2027?
A: The UP Assembly Election 2027 is expected to be held in February-March 2027. The Election Commission of India (ECI) will announce the official schedule approximately 2–3 months before polling.

### Q: How many seats are there in the Uttar Pradesh Vidhan Sabha?
A: The Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly has 403 seats spread across 75 districts. Of these, 84 seats are reserved for Scheduled Castes (SC) and 2 seats for Scheduled Tribes (ST). A party or alliance needs at least 202 seats to form the government.

### Q: Who won the 2022 Uttar Pradesh election?
A: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) won a landslide victory in the 2022 UP Assembly Election, securing 255 of 403 seats with a 41.29% vote share. Yogi Adityanath became Chief Minister.

### Q: What was the 2017 Uttar Pradesh election result?
A: In the 2017 UP Assembly Election, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) won a historic landslide, securing 312 of 403 seats. Yogi Adityanath became Chief Minister.

---

## 4. Methodology & Sourcing
* **Primary Source**: All electoral data is sourced directly from the Election Commission of India (ECI) official records (Form 20 constituency-wise counts and official reports).
* **Data Disclaimers**: Results are approximate and intended for informational, educational, and research purposes.
* **Corrections Policy**: Errors can be reported to contact@indiaelections.org and are corrected within 48 hours of verification against official ECI records.
